subject: Eversafe DPA & SCC pathway — post-demo recap and asks
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Matt Howard <matt.howard@eversafe.com>, security@eversafe.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Eversafe DPA & SCC pathway — post-demo recap and asks

Hey Matt / Elaine / security team — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and clear next steps so legal/procurement can move: 

TL;DR: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II (report available), supports HIPAA (BAA available), and we recommend a processor-style DPA with SCC Module 2 for EU transfer language unless your legal prefers an alternate SCC flavor. Draft DPA and our security pack attached.

Summary of what we covered:
- Use case: Eversafe will send patient-identifiable transcripts from your ingestion pipeline to Redwood’s hosted inference for triage and categorization.
- Security posture: Redwood completed SOC 2 Type II in Apr 2026; centralized logging, encryption at rest/in transit, and role-based access controls.
- Compliance asks: HIPAA BAA available; can support data residency via region routing in Dedicated deployments (if needed).
- DPA/SCC: We generally execute a controller–processor DPA. For cross-border transfers we propose SCC Module 2 (processor-focused module) unless legal requests Module 3 or a bespoke clause.

Action items / asks for Eversafe:
1) Confirm whether Eversafe will be the data controller for the flow described (my assumption based on today’s call) — we need an explicit controller confirmation to finalize the DPA.
2) Tell us if you need a BAA in addition to the DPA.
3) Please complete the attached vendor security questionnaire or tell us if you prefer we post a short intake form (link below). Estimated turn: 3–5 business days for our legal to review once we have controller confirmation.
4) If you want the SOC 2 report, we can provide a redacted copy under NDA — call that out here and we’ll route it.

Docs attached: Redwood_Security_Pack_v3.pdf, Redwood_DPA_Draft_Eversafe.docx
Quick links: vendor questionnaire (https://forms.redwood.ai/eversafe-vsa), HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/9317)

Proposed next step: Jordan + Eversafe legal quick sync Wed 11/24 09:00–09:30 ET — ping me if that works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — Jordan

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0102

Subject: Re: Eversafe DPA & SCC pathway — post-demo recap and asks

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the clear recap. A few clarifying questions from our side: 

On Sat, Nov 21, 2026 at 3:03 PM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> TL;DR: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II (report available), supports HIPAA (BAA available), and we recommend a processor-style DPA with SCC Module 2 for EU transfer language unless your legal prefers an alternate SCC flavor.

Questions:
1) Eversafe will be the data controller for the workflow you described — please proceed with a controller–processor DPA.
2) Can you confirm the date range covered by your SOC 2 Type II (start/end)? Our security team wants to ensure the window covers the last 12 months.
3) We need to know if you support SCC Module 3 — our legal has a strong preference for controller-to-controller language for certain transfers. If not, would Redwood be open to signing an addendum that maps to Module 3?
4) Timeline: we expect to get the vendor questionnaire back to you within 4 business days once we start — what’s your SLA for returning a signed DPA (assuming terms are close)?
5) SOC 2 report: procurement will request a redacted copy. Please send steps to request under NDA.

If you can answer these we’ll route to legal/procurement and get the questionnaire filled.

-Matt
Matt Howard
Head of IT Security, Eversafe Health
matt.howard@eversafe.com | +1 617-555-2424

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Matt Howard <matt.howard@eversafe.com>, security@eversafe.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Eversafe DPA & SCC pathway — post-demo recap and asks

Hi Matt — quick answers inline + a couple of asks.

On Sat, Nov 21, 2026 at 6:24 PM Matt Howard <matt.howard@eversafe.com> wrote:
> 1) Eversafe will be the data controller for the workflow you described — please proceed with a controller–processor DPA.

Understood — we’ll treat Eversafe as controller in the DPA. I attached an updated DPA draft that reflects controller–processor language.

> 2) Can you confirm the date range covered by your SOC 2 Type II (start/end)?

SOC 2 Type II report covers Apr 1, 2025 — Mar 31, 2026. We completed the latest assessment in April 2026. If you need a rolling-coverage statement we can have compliance confirm.

> 3) We need to know if you support SCC Module 3 — our legal has a strong preference for controller-to-controller language for certain transfers.

Short answer: Our standard offering supports SCC Module 2 for processor relationships. We can discuss Module 3 addenda with legal, but that typically requires additional legal review and may impact timelines. If your legal insists on Module 3, please flag that now and we’ll loop our counsel — estimate 7–10 business days for legal to reach a negotiated position (depending on redlines).

> 4) Timeline: we expect to get the vendor questionnaire back to you within 4 business days once we start — what’s your SLA for returning a signed DPA (assuming terms are close)?

If terms are within our standard DPA language, Redwood aims to return an executed DPA within 3 business days of receiving confirmation (DocuSign link below). If there are material redlines, add 7–10 business days.

> 5) SOC 2 report: procurement will request a redacted copy. Please send steps to request under NDA.

We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II under a mutual NDA. To request: 1) send a signed mutual NDA to security@redwood.ai; 2) include the HubSpot deal ID (DEAL-9317) in the request; 3) state the intended recipients. We’ll route the redacted report within 2 business days of NDA receipt.

DocuSign DPA (draft attached): https://docusign.com/envelope/example-dpa-9317
Vendor questionnaire (short form): https://forms.redwood.ai/eversafe-vsa

Next recommended steps:
- Eversafe confirms controller role (you already did) and whether you need a BAA.
- Eversafe signs mutual NDA to receive SOC 2.
- Eversafe returns questionnaire (we’ll prioritize evidence collection once it’s in).
- If Module 3 is non-negotiable, we’ll warm up legal — let us know ASAP.

CC’ing Monica (customer success) to prepare onboarding notes and Tessa (AM) to track the contract timeline. I’ll also add a short list of SOC 2 evidence items we typically provide so Eversafe can prepare.

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
